title: THE DIFFICULTY BUTTON HAS ARROWS LIKE EVERY SWITCH
why: Found in the review of v34.92: every switch in the Settings list shows a small arrow on each side of its value, but the new difficulty button had none, so it looked like a link to another page instead of a switch between new player and main game. It now has the same pair of arrows.
now: The difficulty button shows arrows on both sides, the same as the rows under it.
